akh.text: Samut loses her friend Nakht, who withers to a lifeless husk in the desert, and years later she takes up doubt and searches the ancient parts of Naktamun.

In a sealed chamber in Bontu's Monument she realizes that the God-Pharaoh is the Great Trespasser who caused the calamity, and she begs Djeru not to enter the final Trial because the God-Pharaoh is a lie.
Hazoret curses her and has her imprisoned in a sarcophagus among other dissenters, until the Gatewatch frees her.
In the final Trial she fights beside Djeru, and when Hazoret strikes she tackles him out of the way while Gideon blocks the spear with his golden barrier.

hou.text: Samut fights through the hordes of Naktamun shouting the names of the dead and those she hopes to save, and Djeru admits she was right that the God-Pharaoh lied.
She urges Djeru to lead people out of the city and rallies survivors to fight for tomorrow, whether they believe the God-Pharaoh tested or betrayed them.
When she saves Hazoret from the Scorpion God, her planeswalker spark ignites, and the living bring the god down by driving it onto an obelisk.
Afterward she helps defeat Tezzeret and becomes vizier of Naktamun as Hazoret leads the survivors into the desert.
